_Integrations_help: Real OAuth client credentials never live in this file. Set them with: dotnet user-secrets set Integrations:QuickBooks:ClientId <id>  (locally), or environment variables in prod. Leaving ClientId/ClientSecret blank disables the Sign in with Intuit / Xero buttons gracefully.
